Then (a) |D|^2 <= (l + 1/2) |p - P|^2; and (b) for every j in Fin l and all r, w in R^n with = (D v)_j for every v (r is the j-th row of D), |

- | <= |p - P|^2 ||w||, where e'_j := q(graphPoint 0 (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).
